The '''Royal Zygerrian guard''' served the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire/Legends|Zygerrian Slave Empire]] as its guards and enforcers of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. The royal guards would mount up on domesticated [[Brezak/Legends|brezaks]] and use the large flying creatures to patrol the ground for runaway slaves.<ref name="SWE Brezak">{{SWE|characters|brezak|brezak}}</ref>
